title: Sef Dandia 2026 - Santa Clara
description: Experience the Vibrant SEF Dandia 2026 in Santa Clara
long_description:
Experience the Vibrant SEF Dandia 2026 in Santa Clara
Join us on the
9th of October, 2026
for a spectacular evening filled with music, dance, and culture at the
SEF Dandia 2026 - Santa Clara
event. Immensely popular among Gujarati, Hindi, and multilingual communities, this Navratri/Dandiya event will be a feast for the senses. Thrill to the rhythm of live music in concert, embrace the joy of traditional Dandiya dance, and let the enchanting songs of Bollywood sweep you off your feet. Don't miss out on this unforgettable night!
Meet the Mesmerizing Preetysha Anjan
We are thrilled to present
Preetysha Anjan
, our talented performer for the evening. A renowned Bollywood singer, Preetysha is classically trained in Hindustani vocals and has a knack for capturing crowds with her magical performances. Her unique style, which includes breathing control, precise pronunciation, and the ability to sing to the rhythm of a live orchestra, has captivated audiences worldwide. Come and experience her captivating musical prowess live!
The Santa Clara Convention Center: The Perfect Venue
Our event will take place at the prestigious
Santa Clara Convention Center
, located at 5001 Great America Pkwy, Santa Clara, CA, United States. This iconic venue is renowned for its safety, accessibility, and fantastic location. With ample parking and a plethora of Indian restaurants nearby, your evening is guaranteed to be hassle-free. So why wait? Come and soak in the festive atmosphere at this remarkable venue.
Grab Your Tickets Now!
Secure your spot for the SEF Dandia 2026 now! We offer a variety of ticket options to suit every guest. Early Bird Individual tickets are priced at $20.00, while Groups of 10+ can enjoy a reduced rate of $18.00 per person. Children aged 5 & under can join in the fun for free! Post Early Bird tickets are also available with General Individual tickets at $25.00 and Groups of 4 at $22.00. Don't forget to pick up your Dandia Sticks, available for just $7.00. Hurry, tickets are selling fast!
